alter table storage.objects add column if not exists path_tokens text[] generated always as (string_to_array("name", '/')) stored;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.search(prefix text, bucketname text, limits int DEFAULT 100, levels int DEFAULT 1, offsets int DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE (
    name text,
    id uuid,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    last_accessed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    metadata jsonb
  )
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
	return query 
		with files_folders as (
			select path_tokens[levels] as folder
			from storage.objects
			where objects.name ilike prefix || '%'
			and bucket_id = bucketname
			GROUP by folder
			limit limits
			offset offsets
		) 
		select files_folders.folder as name, objects.id, objects.updated_at, objects.created_at, objects.last_accessed_at, objects.metadata from files_folders 
		left join storage.objects
		on prefix || files_folders.folder = objects.name
        where objects.id is null or objects.bucket_id=bucketname;
END
$function$;
alter table storage.objects add column if not exists version text default null;

ALTER TABLE storage.objects
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS objects_owner_fkey;
ALTER TABLE storage.objects ALTER COLUMN id SET DEFAULT gen_random_uuid();

ALTER TABLE storage.objects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_metadata jsonb NULL;
ALTER TABLE storage.s3_multipart_uploads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_metadata jsonb NULL;

-- postgres-migrations disable-transaction
DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS objects_bucket_id_level_idx;

-- postgres-migrations ignore
-- Add level column to objects
ALTER TABLE storage.objects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS level INT NULL;

--- Index Functions
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "storage"."get_level"("name" text)
    RETURNS int
AS $func$
SELECT array_length(string_to_array("name", '/'), 1);
$func$ LANGUAGE SQL IMMUTABLE STRICT;

-- Table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "storage"."prefixes" (
    "bucket_id" text,
    "name" text COLLATE "C" NOT NULL,
    "level" int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ("storage"."get_level"("name")) STORED,
    "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
    "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT "prefixes_bucketId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("bucket_id") REFERENCES "storage"."buckets"("id"),
    PRIMARY KEY ("bucket_id", "level", "name")
);

ALTER TABLE storage.prefixes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

	ID uuid.UUID `json:"id" db:"id"`

	Aud       string             `json:"aud" db:"aud"`
	Role      string             `json:"role" db:"role"`
	Email     storage.NullString `json:"email" db:"email"`
	IsSSOUser bool               `json:"-" db:"is_sso_user"`

	EncryptedPassword *string    `json:"-" db:"encrypted_password"`
	EmailConfirmedAt  *time.Time `json:"email_confirmed_at,omitempty" db:"email_confirmed_at"`
	InvitedAt         *time.Time `json:"invited_at,omitempty" db:"invited_at"`

	Phone            storage.NullString `json:"phone" db:"phone"`
	PhoneConfirmedAt *time.Time         `json:"phone_confirmed_at,omitempty" db:"phone_confirmed_at"`

	ConfirmationToken  string     `json:"-" db:"confirmation_token"`
	ConfirmationSentAt *time.Time `json:"confirmation_sent_at,omitempty" db:"confirmation_sent_at"`

	// For backward compatibility only. Use EmailConfirmedAt or PhoneConfirmedAt instead.
	ConfirmedAt *time.Time `json:"confirmed_at,omitempty" db:"confirmed_at" rw:"r"`

	RecoveryToken  string     `json:"-" db:"recovery_token"`
	RecoverySentAt *time.Time `json:"recovery_sent_at,omitempty" db:"recovery_sent_at"`

	EmailChangeTokenCurrent  string     `json:"-" db:"email_change_token_current"`
	EmailChangeTokenNew      string     `json:"-" db:"email_change_token_new"`
	EmailChange              string     `json:"new_email,omitempty" db:"email_change"`
	EmailChangeSentAt        *time.Time `json:"email_change_sent_at,omitempty" db:"email_change_sent_at"`
	EmailChangeConfirmStatus int        `json:"-" db:"email_change_confirm_status"`

	PhoneChangeToken  string     `json:"-" db:"phone_change_token"`
	PhoneChange       string     `json:"new_phone,omitempty" db:"phone_change"`
	PhoneChangeSentAt *time.Time `json:"phone_change_sent_at,omitempty" db:"phone_change_sent_at"`

	ReauthenticationToken  string     `json:"-" db:"reauthentication_token"`
	ReauthenticationSentAt *time.Time `json:"reauthentication_sent_at,omitempty" db:"reauthentication_sent_at"`

	LastSignInAt *time.Time `json:"last_sign_in_at,omitempty" db:"last_sign_in_at"`

	AppMetaData  JSONMap `json:"app_metadata" db:"raw_app_meta_data"`
	UserMetaData JSONMap `json:"user_metadata" db:"raw_user_meta_data"`

	Factors    []Factor   `json:"factors,omitempty" has_many:"factors"`
	Identities []Identity `json:"identities" has_many:"identities"`

	CreatedAt   time.Time  `json:"created_at" db:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt   time.Time  `json:"updated_at" db:"updated_at"`
	BannedUntil *time.Time `json:"banned_until,omitempty" db:"banned_until"`
	DeletedAt   *time.Time `json:"deleted_at,omitempty" db:"deleted_at"`
	IsAnonymous bool       `json:"is_anonymous" db:"is_anonymous"`

	DONTUSEINSTANCEID uuid.UUID `json:"-" db:"instance_id"`

}

// JWTConfiguration holds all the JWT related configuration.

	Secret           string         `json:"secret" required:"true"`
	Exp              int            `json:"exp"`
	Aud              string         `json:"aud"`
	AdminGroupName   string         `json:"admin_group_name" split_words:"true"`
	AdminRoles       []string       `json:"admin_roles" split_words:"true"`
	DefaultGroupName string         `json:"default_group_name" split_words:"true"`
	Issuer           string         `json:"issuer"`
	KeyID            string         `json:"key_id" split_words:"true"`
	Keys             JwtKeysDecoder `json:"keys"`
	ValidMethods     []string       `json:"-" split_words:"true"`

	SigningKey func(context.Context) (any, error) `json:"-"`
}

storage.inventory_order_basis: Static DBMigration declaration ordinals 1 through 67 matched to all 67 tracked tenant SQL files, including 00010 numeric ordinal 10. Does not assert unvendored external loader ordering.

external_dependency.name: postgres-migrations
external_dependency.limitations: loadMigrationFiles, validateMigrationHashes, runMigration and bundled migration0 internals are absent from frozen source. storage.migrations hash varchar(40) comment describes SHA1 of filename and contents, not this asset SHA256; exact package hash algorithm/result and external transaction behavior are UNVERIFIED.

wrapper_semantics.rule: Cache a loadMigrationFiles promise by directory; rejection removes cache entry. lastLocalMigrationName chooses external array tail unless configured freeze name exists; unknown freeze throws. This does not establish installed catalog or successful application.

Tenant standard directory is ./migrations/tenant, schema storage. Optional upToMigration finds exact name and slices through inclusive index; missing throws. dbMigrationFreezeAt is not automatically applied to the runMigrations loop here; lastLocalMigrationName and explicit upToMigration are distinct.

Read history id <= lastMigrationId ORDER BY id; optionally backport pathtoken position index2 to storage-schema, rewriting IDs/hashes/history. Call external hash validator; on mismatch throw when refresh false, otherwise refresh hashes transactionally. Default source expression allows hash refresh unless configured false. Rewritten hashes/rows cannot prove actual DDL execution.

Any loaded SQL containing exact -- postgres-migrations ignore replaces sql and contents with SELECT 1; retaining remaining migration object fields, then transformers and external runMigration are called. Oriole access method adds concurrent-index transformer. No migration SQL/code is executed by this task.

Return accumulated external runMigration results; wrap errors with current/intended migration metadata. Separate tenant status update defaults COMPLETED and latest name; up-to-date compares declared DBMigration ordinal plus COMPLETED. resetMigration can insert history records and mark completion without executing their SQL. Latest row/tag/completed status is insufficient catalog evidence.

candidate_catalog.qualification: Conditional candidate for exact successfully applied prefix through 67 with removals actually effective; no actual installed claim. Fresh path skips 16 historical ignore SQL files; a previously applied historical prefix may have their structures until verified removed.

historical_prefix_effects.rule: Historical migration26 SQL adds level/prefix structures but wrapper skips it at this source. Historical41 declares an object level UPDATE trigger; ignored42 removes it in its raw SQL. Historical43 conditionally skips a level repair when migration40 was applied in the last minute; it is also ignored by this wrapper. Migration50 removes five object prefix-maintenance triggers. Any surviving objects_update_level_trigger is forbidden in the candidate catalog. Migration52 conditionally removes prefix triggers, level and functions with EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; level removal may silently fail. DROP prefixes CASCADE is outside those swallowed blocks. Exact absence must be independently catalog checked, not inferred from history row67.

provider_triggers.name: update_objects_updated_at
provider_triggers.function_schema: Candidate storage with source searchPath storage/public/extensions plus optional additions; unqualified CREATE OR REPLACE resolution/existing namespace binding must independently be verified

provider_triggers.name: protect_objects_delete
provider_triggers.formula: If COALESCE(current_setting(storage.allow_delete_query,true),false) != true, raise 42501; otherwise RETURN NULL

source_requested_function_removals.qualification: Migration52 empty-argument drops are specific signatures and may miss typed overloads; migration59 explicitly removes typed listed overloads. All expected absence/prefix-side-effect bindings require actual guarded catalog inspection; not inferred blanket removal.

candidate_catalog.function_definition_policy: Exact source spans and hashes freeze candidate definitions; fresh catalog must independently verify normalized complete definitions/bindings/enabled status, Pals triggers and absence of prefix side effects. Names alone insufficient.

pals_trigger_descriptors.name: pals_require_active_photo_insert
pals_trigger_descriptors.formula: Target NEW; profile-photos authenticated/service_role branch verifies fixed owner identity/path and locks live pilot owner evidence. Nonclient privileged SQL role branches return NEW; no public permission credit.

pals_trigger_descriptors.name: pals_require_active_photo_delete
pals_trigger_descriptors.formula: Target OLD; same live authenticated owner/pilot checks then RETURN OLD. Service role branch rejects DELETE. Provider protect_delete and referenced-photo protections remain independent.

pals_trigger_descriptors.name: pals_reject_client_profile_photo_update
pals_trigger_descriptors.formula: Old/new profile-photos plus authenticated/service_role rejects42501 Profile photos are immutable; other roles RETURN NEW.
